title: docs: add a repository security policy (SECURITY.md)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AB5AVNK6zxdTzUK1owwiGP)_

Fixes #36751
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在仓库「Security」页，原来的「未检测到安全政策」变成一份安全政策，告诉外部研究者通过私密渠道报告漏洞、哪些版本修安全问题、多久回复。
- 为什么做：仓库公开并发布 npm 包，研究者找到漏洞时没有任何地方指向私密报告，可能直接提公开 issue，等于提前公开漏洞。
- 出错会怎样：只是一份文档，不改任何代码、不发版；写得不对直接改或撤回这次合并即可。
- 要你做什么：拍板两项承诺（只修最新大版本；3 个工作日确认、10 个工作日定性、按严重程度的修复时限），以及文档站已公开的「邮箱报告、1 个工作日回复」是否要统一，见下方 Maintainer's call。

## What changes

Adds `SECURITY.md` at the repository root (one new file, 71 lines, nothing else). GitHub renders it on the Security → Policy tab. It says:

1. **How to report** — through private vulnerability reporting (the repository's `/security/advisories/new` form), never a public issue, discussion or pull request; what a report should include (package and version, reproduction, impact, preconditions).
2. **Supported versions** — the latest major line gets security fixes, older majors do not. The line is named by a rule ("every release whose major version equals the newest release on npm"), not by a number, so the file does not go stale at the next major.
3. **Response targets** — acknowledgement within 3 business days, triage verdict within 10, and a fix target by severity (critical 14 days, high 30, medium 90, low in a regular release), all stated as targets, not guarantees.
4. **Disclosure** — the fix ships in a normal release, then the advisory is published with affected and patched versions; a CVE is requested for high and critical; the reporter is credited with permission.
5. **Scope** — the source and npm packages of this repository; a finding in a hosted ObjectStack service is reported the same way and labelled as such.

No real vulnerability or advisory is named anywhere in the file.

## Maintainer's call

Two policy choices are written as the card proposed and are yours to confirm or change in review:

- **Supported versions:** latest major line only (`18.x` at the time of writing — every published `@objectstack/*` package is 18.6.0, one fixed version group).
- **Response and fix targets:** 3 / 10 business days, and 14 / 30 / 90 days / next regular release by severity. The card proposed "a fix target by severity" without numbers; the four numbers are this PR's proposal.

One inconsistency this PR surfaces but does not settle (it lives in another repository): the docs site already publishes a different channel and promise. `docs.objectos.ai` `content/docs/reference/security.mdx` ("Vulnerability disclosure") and `content/docs/resources/support.mdx` tell reporters to email a security mailbox and promise a reply within **1 business day**; the cloud enterprise security questionnaire quotes the same. This file follows the card and the dispatch order (private vulnerability reporting only, 3 business days). Options: (a) keep this file as is and align the docs site to it in a docs-repo card; (b) also list the mailbox here as a second channel and/or change the acknowledgement target to 1 business day. Recommendation: (a), one channel, because a mailbox report cannot become a draft advisory without being copied by hand.

## Why

The repository is public and ships npm packages, and private vulnerability reporting is already enabled (`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/private-vulnerability-reporting` → `{"enabled": true}`, read 2026-11-23), but the Security tab says "No security policy detected" and nothing points a reporter at the private form.

## Tests

None: a Markdown document only, no code path and no tested behaviour. Premise re-read on base `0e83fe03` before writing: no `SECURITY.md` at the root, in `.github/` or in `docs/`; all 76 non-private package manifests read 18.x.

## Acceptance notes

- Publishes nothing: the file is at the repository root, outside every package's `files[]`, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- The organization has no default `SECURITY.md` either (per the card's reading); this PR covers this repository only, as the card asks.

## Verification

Local gates, derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this change set (9 whole-tree families; this path matches no family). Results at head `9e281909`:

Two-minute check: open the branch's `SECURITY.md` on GitHub, or after merge the repository's Security → Policy tab; expected: the policy renders with the "Report a vulnerability" link opening the private advisory form.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no lintable source; CI runs it)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — this one publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: no.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 section is the required Chinese summary).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
